heading: Stories grown in the Marginarium
first_line: Paul Bordjadze built Paint by Moonlight; the Marginarium tells how it was made, in chapters, with a small team of AI agents.
content_why: The chapters live only in Claude Docs, which a visitor without an account can't open, so the full text has to sit on GitHub for anyone to read.
avoid: Avoid claiming the in-app Marginarium already exists, and avoid glossy banners or stat badges, which feel slick and manufactured.
